title: Adverbs of Place
intro: Adverb of place menjelaskan di mana sesuatu terjadi: here, there, outside, inside, upstairs, everywhere, nowhere. Biasanya diletakkan setelah kata kerja atau setelah objek.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct adverb of place
exercises.question: Please sit ___.
exercises.explanation: Here menjelaskan tempat. Now adalah waktu, quickly adalah cara, dan always adalah frekuensi.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct adverb of place
exercises.question: The children are playing ___.

exercises.prompt: Match each adverb to its type
exercises.explanation: Here dan upstairs menjelaskan tempat, tomorrow menjelaskan waktu, dan carefully menjelaskan cara.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Adverb of place diletakkan setelah kata kerja: is sleeping upstairs.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Adverb of place diletakkan setelah objek: put my books there.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with an adverb of place
exercises.sentence: It is raining, so we will stay ___ (in the house).
exercises.explanation: Inside berarti di dalam rumah, lawan katanya outside.

exercises.question: Pick the correct sentence.
options: She looked everywhere for her keys.
She looked for everywhere her keys.
Everywhere she looked her keys for.
exercises.answer: She looked everywhere for her keys.
exercises.explanation: Adverb of place diletakkan setelah kata kerja: looked everywhere.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct adverb of place
exercises.question: Come ___ and see my new bike.
exercises.explanation: Here berarti di tempat pembicara, sedangkan there berarti tempat yang jauh dari pembicara.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about where you study, using an adverb of place.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan adverb yang menjelaskan tempat, misalnya 'I study upstairs every evening.'
